outcome: Completed bounded pilot; no convincing benefit on targeted prose. Candidate not promoted and temporary weights removed.

training.note: Same fixed 72-step recipe run twice from the same original C3 checkpoint because original trainer discarded the final checkpoint on its chain screening metric. Second run retained the final checkpoint for production-tree evaluation, with identical screening results. No parameter search.

screening.meaning: 64-anchor floating-point screening proxy, not live speed or full production-tree acceptance.

interpretation: Quantized tree replay saved two rounds over 2043 identical target tokens: 767 versus 765, +0.26% tokens/round. Mean tree length across all 2041 eligible anchors was identical. This is effectively flat.
Live prose was unchanged/slightly slower. Live code was 7.1% faster but sampled outputs differed; one trial cannot establish a repeatable speedup.
This proves the bounded collect-capture-continue-train-quantize-evaluate workflow is feasible with existing tools, not that 4096 tokens from one task are sufficient for useful generalization.
No claim of comprehensive quality validation. Next useful trial would require more diverse hard segments and stronger held-out coverage, not just more epochs on this sample.
limitations: One training task and one held-out prose task; category-targeted rather than per-token failure-mined training. No representative easy replay examples in the training mixture; code served as a regression probe only.
Synthetic randomized archive supplies context depth; it is not a real conversation workload.
Captures processed the full 205K prefix before retaining local feature windows with absolute positions. Features came from the existing q4_0 capture runtime.

Capture wrapper initially applied a greedy rank-one mismatch threshold to sampled outputs. Report-only recheck used the existing sampled-data tolerance; every supervised token was within teacher replay top-16. No feature recapture or content substitution.

Live baseline held-out prompt reused the synthetic prefix; candidate began from cold prefill. Reported speed excludes prefill, but prefill shape and different drafts can change sampled output through rounding. Paired replay controls the target token sequence.

runtime.power_policy: Existing 300 W per-card policy and clock settings unchanged
runtime.gpu0: Used for training-case feature capture, training and replay
runtime.gpu3: Used for synthetic generation, held-out feature capture and live evaluation

cleanup.retained: Compact report, scripts, synthetic token streams and scalar evaluation evidence only.
